Flagged in the research report (Finding 1 scope note, Recommendation 7) for the plan to decide whether to fold in.

Research report identified an existing in-repo propagation mechanism (canonical fragment + lint-agent-contracts.sh Check C/G/H pattern) plus the exact next free check letter, so plan construction was mechanical rather than exploratory.
